description: POST-HOC space, declared after seeing the development-phase agent proposals (not the held-out run). It systematically explores the dimensions the agents introduced: nitrite-ammonium comproportionation to N2 (NO2- + NH4+ -> N2, electrons 0, second order), a separate deactivation time constant for every nitrogen-loss step, and one shared free reaction order on nitrate-consuming steps. Used to attribute agent gains to model-space expansion versus search within a space.
